error_reason: The orchestrator mis-specified the ISBN-10 check digit algorithm as using weights (position + 1), i.e., 2..10 left-to-right, instead of the correct 10..2 weights on the first nine digits. This foundational error set the wrong computational target; had the algorithm been specified correctly at step 1, the subsequent data handling and calculation would have been aligned, preventing the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The orchestrator specified the ISBN-10 algorithm incorrectly: it stated using sum of nine digits multiplied by (position + 1), which is the 1..9 weighting scheme. ISBN-10 check digit computation for the first nine digits uses weights 10..2 (or equivalently positions 10 down to 2). This early mis-specification likely led to adopting an arbitrary extraction of digits from a UUID-like Tropicos ID later and mismatched weighting. Correctly specifying the algorithm at this step would have forced proper verification and likely prevented the downstream incorrect calculation.
